title: Jira Per-Team Multi-Project Configuration
description: Per-team configuration for the @pennymac/jira promp package, supporting multiple Jira projects within a single Atlassian site. Resolves logical placeholders (channelFieldId, workStreamFieldId, etc.) to project-specific Jira custom field IDs and provides default values so workflow skills don't have to ask on every create. Generated by the configure-jira skill; verified by the verify-jira-config skill. The top-level `site` and `defaultProjectKey` are repo-wide; everything project-scoped (fieldIds, defaults, issueTypeOverrides, customExtras) lives under `projects.<KEY>`. Workflow skills resolve the active project key (from a prompt parameter, the project portion of an issue key, or `defaultProjectKey`) and then read only the matching `projects.<KEY>` entry. The placeholders intentionally excluded from this schema are: storyIssueTypeId, taskIssueTypeId, bugIssueTypeId, subTaskIssueTypeId, epicIssueTypeId (vestigial — workflow skills use issueTypeName strings instead) and acReadyFieldId (documented in jira-field-mappings.md but never consumed by any skill).

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference. Set to a relative path or URL pointing at this schema file.

site.description: Atlassian site identity. One site per repo (multi-instance is not supported in this version). Optional — when omitted, workflow skills auto-discover the cloudId via getAccessibleAtlassianResources at runtime.

cloudId.description: Atlassian cloud UUID. Cached here to avoid an MCP discovery call on every invocation.

defaultProjectKey.description: Project key the workflow skills target by default when no projectKey parameter is supplied and the operation does not derive one from an issue key. Must be a key present in `projects`. Example: 'AIP'.

projects.description: Map of Jira project key (e.g. 'AIP', 'PCG') to that project's per-team configuration. Each project entry is self-contained — there is no inheritance or merging across projects. At least one entry is required (the schema requires `projects` at the top level; this map MAY be empty in transient configure-jira intermediate states but a useful config has at least one entry).

projectEntry.description: Configuration for a single Jira project: field-ID resolution, defaults, per-issue-type overrides, and project-specific custom-field extras.

fieldIds.description: Mapping of logical field names (used in skill placeholders like {{channelFieldId}}) to this project's Jira custom field IDs. Set to null when this project does not expose that field — the workflow skills will detect null and degrade gracefully (e.g., null acceptanceCriteria flips Epic AC mode to inline-description).

acceptanceCriteria.description: Custom field ID for Acceptance Criteria (ADF format). Resolves the {{acceptanceCriteriaFieldId}} placeholder. Set null when this project does not expose AC as a custom field on a given issue type — see issueTypeOverrides.<Type>.acceptanceCriteriaMode for the per-type override.

channel.description: Custom field ID for the Channel multi-select. Resolves {{channelFieldId}}.

workStream.description: Custom field ID for the Work-Stream single-select. Resolves {{workStreamFieldId}}.

teams.description: Custom field ID for the Teams multi-select. Resolves {{teamsFieldId}}.

storyPoints.description: Custom field ID for the numeric Story Points estimate. Resolves {{storyPointsFieldId}}. Unlike the select fields, this one takes a bare number rather than an option object. Many project workflows validate on it (for example, requiring Story Points before an issue may leave Backlog), so leaving it null means estimation-aware flows cannot set an estimate. Set null when this project does not expose Story Points.

bugEnvironment.description: Custom field ID for the Bug Environment single-select. Resolves {{bugEnvironmentFieldId}}.

bugSeverity.description: Custom field ID for the Bug Severity single-select. Resolves {{bugSeverityFieldId}}.

bugTestPhase.description: Custom field ID for the Bug Test Phase single-select. Resolves {{bugTestPhaseFieldId}}.

bugResponsibleTeam.description: Custom field ID for the Bug Responsible Development Team single-select. Resolves {{bugResponsibleTeamFieldId}}.

epicName.description: Custom field ID for the separate Epic Name field, when this project keeps Epic Name distinct from summary. Resolves {{epicNameFieldId}}.

epicStartDate.description: Custom field ID for the Epic target start date. Resolves {{epicStartDateFieldId}}.

epicEndDate.description: Custom field ID for the Epic target end date. Resolves {{epicEndDateFieldId}}.

epicTheme.description: Custom field ID for the Epic theme single-select. Resolves {{epicThemeFieldId}}.

defaults.description: Default values the workflow skills use when prompt parameters do not supply one. User-provided inputs always override these. Defaults are project-scoped because Channel / Work-Stream / Team allowed-values typically differ per project.

channel.description: Default Channel option value, e.g. 'PCG'. Must be one of this project's allowed Channel values.

workStream.description: Default Work-Stream option value, e.g. 'AI Platform Services'.

subtaskTrackingLabel.description: Required label every Sub-task must include for tracking, e.g. 'subtask'.

bugTestPhase.description: Default Bug Test Phase value, e.g. 'Production'.

bugResponsibleTeam.description: Default Bug Responsible Development Team value, e.g. 'Pennymac'.

issueTypeOverrides.description: Per-issue-type overrides for behavior the workflow skills would otherwise infer from the package's default profile. Keyed by issue type name as Jira returns it ('Story', 'Task', 'Bug', 'Sub-task', 'Epic', or any custom issue type this project defines).

acceptanceCriteriaMode.description: Overrides the package's default AC handling for this issue type. 'adf-field' sets AC on the AC custom field via a separate API call after creation; 'inline-description' appends AC into the description before creation; 'none' skips AC entirely. Detect at configure-jira time by inspecting whether the AC custom field is exposed on this issue type in this project.

channelRequired.description: Overrides the package's default Channel-required posture for this issue type. AIP Epic, for example, sets this to false because Channel is not required for Epic in AIP even though it is for Story/Task/Bug.

customExtras.description: Open map of additional logical names to this project's custom field IDs for project-specific fields the package does not know about (e.g. 'tShirtSize' -> 'customfield_10190', 'objective' -> 'customfield_11624'). The workflow skills do not auto-include these — they are available for prompt parameters or per-team extensions to reference. verify-jira-config treats values appearing here as covering required custom fields the package does not have logical names for.
